content.text: The problem here is that there is a bug in how Fedora handles and produces ETags and Last-Modified headers for Binary descriptions. See this gist for some of the peculiarities of how Fedora behaves:

The web UI does not refresh the binary resource /fcr:metadata display page after a binary resource property is added.  In order to see the update to the property reflected, you must force a non-cached reload of the page with Shift+refresh.
This may be related to the etag issue described in FCREPO-1498.
